data.name: Aaliya
data.gender_notes: Aaliya is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Aaliya is a graceful Arabic name meaning 'exalted', 'high-ranking', or 'lofty'. It reflects dignity, nobility, and spiritual elevation, symbolizing a person of high status and virtue. The name Aaliya carries the meaning “Exalted, Lofty, High-ranking” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Arabic. Parents who choose Aaliya usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted, lofty, high-ranking and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents elevated spiritual and moral qualities, purity of heart, and noble character.
data.etymology: Aaliya belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Exalted, Lofty, High-ranking.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aaliya total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
